chapter_title: 第三十八章 熱帶的症及看護的法 (Jia̍t-tài ê Chèng kap Khàn-hō͘ ê Hoat)
text:
Fig. 1.—The parasite of tertian fever.  
Saⁿ-ji̍t-jia̍t ê goân-thâng.

> **【全漢對照】**
> Fig. 1.—The parasite of tertian fever.  
> 三日熱的原蟲。

---

Fig. 2.—The parasite of quartan fever.  
Sì-ji̍t-jia̍t ê goân-thâng.

> **【全漢對照】**
> Fig. 2.—The parasite of quartan fever.  
> 四日熱的原蟲。

---

Fig. 3.—The parasite of æstivo-autumnal fever.  
Ok-sèng-jia̍t ê goân-thâng.

> **【全漢對照】**
> Fig. 3.—The parasite of æstivo-autumnal fever.  
> 惡性熱的原蟲。

---

Fig. 4.—Crescentic and oval bodies. Fig. 5.—Flagellated forms.  
Seng-sit-thé(生殖體); pòaⁿ-goa̍t-hêng. Piⁿ-mô͘-tih-thâng-lūi (鞭毛滴蟲類).

> **【全漢對照】**
> Fig. 4.—Crescentic and oval bodies. Fig. 5.—Flagellated forms.  
> 生殖體（生殖體）；半月形。鞭毛滴蟲類（鞭毛滴蟲類）。

---

Tē 483 tô͘.—Malaria goân-thâng hoat-io̍k tī huih-nih chōng-thài ê tô͘.  
(From Hutchison and Rainy's "Clinical Methods," Cassell and Co., publishers.)

> **【全漢對照】**
> 第 483 圖。—Malaria（瘧疾）原蟲發育佇血裡狀態的圖。  
> (From Hutchison and Rainy's "Clinical Methods," Cassell and Co., publishers.)
